Strongly typed IMemoryCache<TCacheId> with enum cache identifiers, on top of Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory, for single-instance applications.

Strongly typed caching with enum cache identifiers instead of magic strings: the IMemoryCache<TCacheId> and IDistributedCache<TCacheId> interfaces, their base classes, CacheEntryOptions and the CacheKey attribute. The InMemory, Distributed and RedisHybrid packages implement them.

Strongly typed IDistributedCache<TCacheId> with enum cache identifiers, on top of any registered IDistributedCache provider (Redis, SQL Server, memory and others). Values are serialized with MessagePack, with LZ4 compression on by default.

Strongly typed IDistributedCache<TCacheId> with enum cache identifiers that combines a local in-memory cache with Redis and keeps the instances in sync through Redis pub/sub (Foundatio.Redis). Values are serialized with MessagePack.
